decisive_items: not adherent to the overlying skin
response.rationale: Epidermal inclusion cyst best fits a slow-growing, firm, non-transilluminating, non-tender nodule on the hand without trauma; pilomatrixoma is a plausible alternative but typically smaller and more common in younger patients.

rejected.why: Dermatofibroma usually smaller and adherent to skin; size and non-adherence here are atypical.
Keloid requires prior trauma, which is explicitly absent.
Ganglion cyst is typically transilluminating and softer; non-transilluminating firm nodule argues against.
Lipoma is usually soft and compressible; firm consistency is inconsistent.
